_comment: Domain knowledge for deterministic (offline) agents. Each acceptance criterion names the tests that verify it; the ac-traceability gate enforces that those tests ran and passed.

criteria.text: POST /api/v1/urls returns 201 with a 7-character short code for a valid http(s) URL
Generated codes are unique and non-sequential (no collisions by construction)
GET /{code} answers 302 to the target URL; unknown codes answer 404
Custom aliases are unique: a duplicate answers 409, including under concurrent requests
GET /api/v1/urls/{code}/stats returns total clicks, a daily series, top referrers and browser families
Recording analytics never blocks or fails a redirect (bounded async queue; drops are counted)
Create is idempotent per Idempotency-Key: a retry replays the same link, a different body answers 422
API calls are rate-limited per API key and redirects per client IP (429 with Retry-After)
Non-http(s), internal, private-IP and credential-bearing URLs are rejected with 400
Visitor IPs are stored only as a salted HMAC; only referrer host and browser family are kept
A link may carry an optional expiresAt; once reached, the redirect answers 410 Gone
Links without expiresAt never expire, and an expiresAt in the past is rejected with 400
Links to known third-party URL shorteners are rejected with 400, so a short link cannot hide its real destination

features.title: Fix SSRF bypass via alternative IP encodings

criteria.text: Hosts in non-canonical numeric IP notation (decimal, hex, octal, zero-padded) are rejected with 400, while canonical public IPs and hostnames still work

ambiguities.question: 'Safer' could mean several things. Which safety risk should this change address?

options.label: Block links that point to other URL shorteners (redirect chains hide the destination)
options.requirementText: Block links to known third-party URL shorteners to prevent redirect chains.

options.label: Make links expire automatically
options.requirementText: Links may carry an expiry; expired links answer 410.

options.label: Check targets against a phishing/malware threat feed
options.requirementText: Integrate a third-party threat-intelligence feed (out of scope: needs an external vendor and a dependency review).

ambiguities.question: Which additional visitor data is in scope for analytics?

options.label: Keep today's privacy-safe aggregates (referrer host, browser family)
options.requirementText: Keep analytics privacy-safe: only referrer host and browser family.

options.label: Store each visitor's raw IP address for detailed tracking
options.requirementText: Store the raw IP address of every visitor.

options.label: Country-level geolocation (derived at click time, IP not stored)
options.requirementText: Add country-level geolocation (out of scope: needs a licensed GeoIP database).
